Where each fact comes from:
- **Town of Oakville:** 
The Town offers lessons under the Lifesaving Society Swim for Life program.
 
Its rates and fees list covers "All Preschool Levels A - E".
 
Fall registration opened Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.
 
The Registered Programs page says fall registration is now open and winter registration opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7 a.m.
 No class times or prices are on the pages I read. The booking pages sit behind a login.
- **YMCA of Oakville:** 
The Preschool Swim Lessons program is for ages 3-5.
 
Its swim programs run in 12-week sessions with a one-week break.
 I did not find class days, times or a price.
- **Making Waves Swim School:** 
Little Waves, for ages 2-5, is listed at $33.13 per lesson.
 
The page says to register anytime.
 It gives no class days or times.
